biome_based_crops.guide.title: Biomes Notebook
biome_based_crops.guide.no_floor: Arrr! Nay specific floor blocks required.
biome_based_crops.guide.setup_text: Arrr! Once the cabin reaches the required temperature and meets the floor and interior block requirements, it will register as that biome, enabling mobs and other creatures to spawn in it too. Crops and saplings need sky-exposed glass directly above each plant. The rest of the roof can be solid. Nay AC is needed when the natural climate matches the requirement. To change the climate, point an AC into the cabin. Use one AC unit per 256 enclosed interior blocks. Faint air wisps indicate openings. Seal them within one minute, before the climate starts returning to its natural state.
biome_based_crops.ac.selector_usage: Arrr! Tap to cycle forward. Hold Shift or use the left arrow key to cycle backward.
